meta.description: Moteur de contenu (BUILD) — ingère un document dans le RAG : crée l'entrée documents, découpe en chunks, calcule les embeddings (1536) et les stocke. Entrées : title, source_type, source_uri, entity_type, entity_id, text.

parameters.query: insert into documents(title, source_type, source_uri, entity_type, entity_id, checksum, status) values ($1,$2,$3,nullif($4,''),nullif($5,'')::uuid, md5($6), 'chunked') on conflict (checksum) where checksum is not null do update set status='chunked' returning id as document_id;

insert into document_chunks(document_id, chunk_index, content, embedding) values ($1::uuid, $2::int, $3, ('[' || $4 || ']')::vector) on conflict (document_id, chunk_index) do update set content=excluded.content, embedding=excluded.embedding;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ $('Découper en chunks').item.json.document_id }},={{ $('Découper en chunks').item.json.chunk_index }},={{ $('Découper en chunks').item.json.content }},={{ $json.data[0].embedding.join(',') }}
